On Tue, May 9, 2023 at 12:46 PM Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Cara,
Indeed, I was going to send you an update today. Moving some to bcc to preserve inboxes.
We believe Inigo, cc'd above would be an excellent candidate for participation.

On May 9, 2023, at 9:43 AM, Cara Thanassi <[contact omitted]> wrote:
This Message Is From an External Sender
Hi Sandy,
I hope this finds you well. I am writing to see if you have any updates on Meta's participation in the June
5 Voices event in Costa Rica. We're finalizing the invitation list and panelists and believe Meta
representatives would contribute greatly to the discussion.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Best,
Cara
On Wed, May 3, 2023 at 5:37 PM Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Many thanks for the additional information, Cara. We very much appreciate the opportunity to engage
with you on this important event.
Let me discuss with our team to determine 1) attendees and 2) if we can also support serving as a
panelist.
We'll be in touch soon.
Best,
Sandy

On May 3, 2023, at 4:55 PM, Cara Thanassi <[contact omitted]> wrote:
This Message Is From an External Sender
Dear Sandy,
I am writing to follow up on Mileydi's May 1 email regarding RightsCon. As you may be
aware, there will be a robust USG delegation at RightsCon with various events in the
planning stages. In collaboration with the State Department, we in USAID's Latin America
and Caribbean Bureau are organizing a Monday, June 5 event (approximately 9 AM to
1PM) focused on addressing digital repression/promoting digital democracy in Central
America (see description below). This will occur under the broader umbrella of the
interagency Voices initiative focused on protecting, defending, and promoting civic space
in Central America.
The event will include representatives from civil society organizations, independent
media, the private sector, and donors and largely conducted in Spanish. We are currently
finalizing the invitation list, as well as identifying possible panelists. We would be pleased
if one or more representatives from Meta were available to attend (depending upon final
head counts). Moreover, as we work to identify panelists, would there be interest in
someone from Meta possibly serving in that capacity? We welcome your suggestions on
both participants and potential panelists.
We are currently envisioning one panel that includes civil society and media
representatives from the region and another that encompasses donor and private sector
representatives, with no formal decision made as to their compositions yet.
Please let us know if you have any questions and thanks for your consideration.
Best regards,
Cara
Under the U.S. government's interagency Voices initiative to protect, defend and promote
civic space in Central America, USAID and the State Department will hold a June 5
closed-door side event at the RightsCon Summit in Costa Rica. We will take advantage
of the Summit's focus on human rights in the digital age to gather representatives from
civil society organizations, independent media, donors, and the private sector to
understand the challenges, identify gaps and coordinate responses for the promotion of
digital democracy in Central America. This closed-door consultation will center on the
tactics of digital authoritarianism and repression. This includes online surveillance and
censorship; social manipulation and disinformation; internet restrictions; and the targeted
persecution of independent media, human rights defenders, and other advocates and
activists. By bringing together diverse stakeholders, this conversation aims to highlight
local and regional impacts and responses; share lessons learned between sectors and
countries; identify immediate and longer-term priorities, and further coordination and
collaboration for countering digital authoritarianism in the region.
On Mon, May 1, 2023 at 8:26 AM Mileydi Guilarte <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Sandy.
It was a pleasure meeting you as well and discussing ways that we can continue to
work together throughout the hemisphere.
I am copying my colleague Cara to follow up on the RightsCon panel details as well as
my colleague Luis for the trainings we have pending, including the one in Guatemala
and the upcoming election.

My best,
Mileydi
On Sat, Apr 29, 2023 at 7:42 AM Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Mileydi,
It was a tremendous pleasure to meet you and I wanted to thank you for being so
generous with your time this week. I hope you found the discussion as instructive
and informative as we did.
I also wanted to follow-up on the potential panel at RightsCon. Once I have the
details of the key topics, panel focus and potential additional panelists, I'll share it
with our team to determine the best colleague for potential participation. I'll be back
in DC next week so would be super helpful to be able to share that info with the team
sometime next week. Chantal—if it's easier to connect via phone, let me know.
Happy to jump on a call.
Lastly, I also wanted to thank Chantal for her help in setting up our meeting and also
thank Ryan for his participation in our roundtable discussion (which I believe
everyone left feeling very inspired).
Again, many thanks for your time and know we look forward to deepening our
partnership.
Best to you all for a great weekend!
Sandy
On Apr 21, 2023, at9:40 AM, Luis Azurduy <[contact omitted]>
wrote:
This Message Is From an External Sender
Adding Ryan Knight who will be there too.
On Fri, Apr 21, 2023 at 11:25 AM Mileydi Guilarte
<[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Sandy,
Will be great to meet on the margins of the conference for coffee. I
arrive late on Wednesday but perhaps we can meet Thursday? My
colleague Chantal, copied here, will revert with options.
Unfortunately it looks like I am already committed to be part of
another event Friday morning.
More soon.
Best,
Mileydi
On Fri, Apr 21, 2023 at 11:20 AM Sandra Luff
[opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:

Many thanks for your prompt response, Alex.
So sorry to hear you & Marcela are unable to attend but
look forward to meeting Luis & Mileydi in person. (moving
you & Marcela to bcc to save your inboxes)
Luis & Mileydi--please let me know if you'll have some time
to grab coffee on the sidelines of the Summit. Also, feel
free to connect directly with Stina or Sharon if you'd like to
participate in the events outlined below.
Best,
Sandy

[opaque block] [contact omitted]>wrote:
Dear Marcela,
I hope this finds you well. It is hard to believe almost a
year has passed since the Summit of the Americas.
I wanted to share that our Meta policy teams are excited
to participate in the upcoming Cities Summit of the
Americas and I also wanted to extend an invitation to
you and your team to attend two events Meta is hosting.
Provided below are the details of the events and key
points of contact. We hope you, Alex or a member of
your team will have an opportunity to join us.
Additionally, it your schedule allows, please let me
know if you'll have time to connect for coffee I'd love
to catch up.
Please let me know if you have any questions and know
we look forward to a successful Summit.
Best,
Sandy
Inclusive Economic Recovery Roundtable: We will
host a discussion on how technologies can ignite
inclusive economic impact at the local level. This
conversation will feature Indigenous creators and small
business owners from across the Americas who will
share their perspective on how they express their
cultures and promote their small businesses in innovative
ways. You will hear about the power of technologies to
unlock the economic potential of communities along
with the latest insights into what the future holds for
creating inclusive economies. Please contact Stina

Trainor, cc'd above with questions or to RSVP for the
roundtable. (Note: This is an intimate, invite-only event
on the sidelines of the Cities Summit of the Americas.
Upon confirmation, additional details will be provided).
Friday, April 28, 2023
Four Seasons Hotel Denver
10:30 am - 12:00 pm
Activation, Innovation Plaza: We will offer
demonstrations of Meta's Quest 2 and Quest Pro Virtual
Reality headsets that highlight our vision for the future
of technology as well as the potential positive economic
impact in providing opportunities for creators and small
businesses. We will also showcase the latest in wearable
technology with Ray-Ban Stories smart glasses. Please
contact Sharon Yang, cc'd above with questions or to
